description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) TACTICAL FOCUS (Tacticus Attack Force, 1 CP) — WP-M3a. Fixture sm11e_m3a_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3a_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Marine player gets the seven WP-M3a detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. Every engaged unit counts as having fought (setup privilege) and the phase reaches its Consolidate step; a REAL click on the Assault Intercessors' Consolidate row opens unit_selected_to_consolidate (routed because Player 1 has a stratagem for it); a REAL click spends 1 CP; D3 is rolled and the consolidation move can be up to D3+3".
